text:
customer_ops: Hi folks — since ~11:05am our integration is seeing ~10-15% of requests return 503s for hosted generate endpoints. Happens across regions (usw2, euw1). Customers are impacted.

support_ash: Thanks for the report — can you paste a curl and SDK trace id so we can correlate? Also approximate SDK version? :eyes:

customer_ops: curl we used:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" -H "X-Customer-ID: acme-123" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello","stream":false}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Header from a 503 response: `X-Request-Id: rwd_8f9a3`
SDK: node 1.2.0 with `maxConcurrency: 8`

support_ash: Got it. Filing to eng. tagging @eng_maya and @sre_lee. Temporary ask: please set SDK maxConcurrency to 2 and retry/backoff while we investigate.

eng_maya: I pulled the trace rwd_8f9a3 — LB logs show `503 no healthy upstream` around the same time as autoscale events. There are many short-lived backend instances marked unhealthy then re-added. Possible healthcheck mismatch with new runtime image.

sre_lee: Correlating with infra events — there was a config push to edge-proxy yesterday that tightened healthcheck path TTLs (changed from /hc -> /hc/live) and the new model-server container responds on /hc (legacy). Some hosts fail the check during rollout and are removed causing 503s until the pool replenishes.

customer_ops: That explains the burst pattern. Impact window is ~30-90s per incident but recurring as traffic spikes. Customers are complaining about UX. Any ETA on fix?

eng_maya: Short term mitigation: we can revert the healthcheck config on the edge-proxy to accept both `/hc` and `/hc/live` (fast rollback). I'll prepare a revert PR and coordinate with @deploy-bot for a canary.

sre_lee: Also suggest we add a routing fallback to keep serving through older pool if new pool health < 50% to avoid 503s during rollout. I'll open an infra ticket.

support_ash: Communicating to customer: please reduce concurrency and enable SDK retry with jitter for next 1-2 hours. We'll update you when rollback is deployed.

deploy-bot: deploy started: edge-proxy-config revert (canary) — id: db-2024-09-06-02 — canary in us-west-2 (10% traffic)

eng_maya: Canary looks healthy so far (no new 503s in canary window). If canary stable for 10m we'll promote.

customer_ops: Thanks. Can you share a short note I can send to customers?

support_ash: Draft note: "We observed transient 503 errors during a recent edge configuration rollout that affected a subset of requests. We've reverted the config and are promoting the fix; please temporarily lower SDK concurrency and enable retry/backoff. We're monitoring and will follow up once the rollback is complete." Feel free to copy.

deploy-bot: promote started: edge-proxy-config revert -> global (rolling)

sre_lee: Post-rollback check: host health stabilized, backend pool size back to normal, no new `no healthy upstream` logs in the last 15m.

support_ash: Thanks all — updating customer thread with the note and marking as active
